The specific list of 'Kings of Judah' usually refers to the dynasty of the Southern Kingdom, which began with Rehoboam (Solomon's son) after the split. Even if one argues Solomon was a king of Judah (as part of the united monarchy), the total number of kings of Judah (including the united period) is roughly 20-21. 1/20 is 5%. However, the standard theological and historical distinction separates the 'Kings of Israel' (Northern) and 'Kings of Judah' (Southern). Solomon is the last king of the united monarchy. If we strictly define 'Kings of Judah' as the post-split dynasty, Solomon is 0/20 = 0%. If we include him in the total monarchs of the tribe/region, he is 1/20 = 5%.
